subject: sun_shelter
prompt:
A stylized low-poly 3D video game screenshot, NOT photographic: chunky simplified geometry with softly bevelled edges, flat hand-painted color blocks with almost no fine texture, simplified cloud shapes. Graded like an old glass-plate photograph: slightly desaturated, warm sepia in the shadows and midtones, cool silver highlights, very subtle grain. Palette: red laterite earth, deep olive green foliage, bleached canvas, weathered teak, slate grey-blue sea, silver-grey sky.
Simplified, hand-built forms with softly bevelled edges, like a museum diorama built at 1:1 scale. Large readable silhouettes, few small details. Materials read as their real substance (wood, brass, canvas, glass, brick) through color and broad texture, not micro-detail. The scientific evidence of the scene is the brightest and clearest thing in the frame. Real historical people are depicted respectfully, never as caricatures.
Subject: A single object, a 1919 open-sided field sun-shelter for a telescope, no walls. Parts, bottom to top: four round weathered teak posts about 14 cm thick and 2.9 m tall on a rectangle 4.6 m wide and 6.3 m long; a squared timber tie beam joining the post tops on every side, the rear beam heavier; a taut bleached canvas roof, 5.2 m by 7 m, almost flat with a gentle slope, lashed to the beams with ropes; a short canvas valance hanging 35 cm down along the front edge; at the rear beam a loose roll of spare canvas tied with rope, where the roof is rolled back to open the sky. Empty floor of red earth. Three-quarter view from slightly above, centered, whole object visible, plain neutral light-grey studio background, soft even lighting, no cast shadows on the background.
Reminder of the medium: A stylized low-poly 3D video game screenshot, NOT photographic: chunky simplified geometry with softly bevelled edges, flat hand-painted color blocks with almost no fine texture, simplified cloud shapes.
Avoid: text, letters, captions, watermarks, logos, UI, frames or borders; anachronistic objects; fantasy or steampunk embellishment; observatory domes; neon or saturated cyan/magenta; photorealistic skin pores; lens flares; heavy vignettes.
